-------------------------------------------------
-- INSERT app.StagiuCotizare - PAS 1
-------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO app.StagiuCotizare
(
    Marca, CodSucursala, Luna, Anul,

    ZileLucrate, ZileCO, ZileCM, ZileCFS,
    ZileNemotivate, ZileDelegatie, ZileAsimilate,

    OreLucrate, OreCO, OreCM, OreSuspendate,

    VenitCAS, VenitCASS, VenitCAM,
    VenitCM, VenitFNUASS,
    VenitBrut, VenitImpozabil,

    CASRetinut, CASSRetinut, CAMCalculat, ImpozitRetinut,

    TipContract, TipNorma, NormaZilnica,
    TipAsigurat, TipVenitD112, ConditiiMunca,
    CodIndemnizatieCM, CodCOR,
    CasaPensii, CasaSanatate, Judet,

    EsteCCC, EsteCM, EstePensionar,
    EsteScutitCAS, EsteScutitCASS,
    ContractSuspendat, AreFacilitati, EsteAsimilat,

    TipStagiu, AnStagiu, LunaStagiu,

    CodFunctie,
    CodUrgentaCM,
    EsteCMContinuare,
    EsteCMCronic,
    ProcCM,
    ZileCMUnitate,
    ZileCMFNUASS,

    EsteProcesat, Status, MesajValidare,
    DataCalcul, CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    ep.Marca,
    ep.CodSucursala,
    ep.Luna,
    ep.Anul,

    ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrateTotal,0),
    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0),
    ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0),
    ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS,0),
    ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0),
    ISNULL(ep.ZileDelegatie,0),

    ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0),

    ISNULL(ep.OreLucrate,0),

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0) * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT),

    ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT),

    (
        ISNULL(ep.ZileCFS,0)
        + ISNULL(ep.ZileNemotivate,0)
    ) * CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT),

    ISNULL(bc.BazaCAS,0),
    ISNULL(bc.BazaCASS,0),
    ISNULL(bc.BazaCAM,0),

    ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0),
    ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0) + ISNULL(cm.SumaPldinFondAcc,0),

    ISNULL(bc.BrutTotal,0),
    ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0),

    ISNULL(bc.CAS,0),
    ISNULL(bc.CASS,0),
    ISNULL(bc.CAM,0),
    ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0),

    ISNULL(s.TipAngajare,'STANDARD'),
    ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1),
    CAST(ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) * 8 AS INT),

    '',
    'SALAR',
    'Normale',

    ISNULL(cm.CodIndemnizatieCM,''),

    ISNULL(s.CodFunctie,0),
    '',
    ISNULL(s.CodSanatate,''),
    ISNULL(s.Judet,''),

    CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) > 0
          OR ISNULL(cm.ZileCMTotal,0) > 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END,

    CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,

    0,
    0,

    CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,

    0,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1
          OR ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0) > 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.Stare,0) = 1 THEN 'CCC'
        WHEN ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0) > 0
          OR ISNULL(cm.ZileCMTotal,0) > 0 THEN 'CM'
        WHEN ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0) > 0 THEN 'ASIMILAT'
        ELSE 'CONTRIBUTIV'
    END,

    ep.Anul,
    ep.Luna,

    ISNULL(s.CodFunctie,0),

    ISNULL(cm.CodUrgentaCM,0),
    ISNULL(cm.EsteCMContinuare,0),
    ISNULL(cm.EsteCMCronic,0),
    ISNULL(cm.ProcCM,0),
    ISNULL(cm.ZileCMUnitate,0),
    ISNULL(cm.ZileCMFNUASS,0),

    0,
    1,
    '',
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep

INNER JOIN app.BazaContributii bc
    ON bc.Marca = ep.Marca
   AND bc.Luna = ep.Luna
   AND bc.Anul = ep.Anul
   AND bc.CodSucursala = ep.CodSucursala

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON s.Marca = ep.Marca
   AND s.CodSucursala = ep.CodSucursala
   AND s.Luna = ep.Luna
   AND s.Anul = ep.Anul

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        Marca,
        CodSucursala,
        LunadePlata AS Luna,
        AnuldePlata AS Anul,

        SUM(ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0)) AS ZileCMTotal,
        SUM(ISNULL(NrZileAsimilate,0)) AS NrZileAsimilate,

        SUM(ISNULL(SumaUnitate,0)) AS SumaUnitate,
        SUM(ISNULL(SumaPlatitadinCAS,0)) AS SumaPlatitadinCAS,
        SUM(ISNULL(SumaPldinFondAcc,0)) AS SumaPldinFondAcc,

        MAX(ISNULL(Codindemn,'')) AS CodIndemnizatieCM,

        MAX(ISNULL(TRY_CAST(CodUrgenta AS INT),0)) AS CodUrgentaCM,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(CMContinuare,'') IN ('D','DA','1')
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS EsteCMContinuare,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(Cronic,'') IN ('D','DA','1')
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS EsteCMCronic,

        MAX(ISNULL(ProcentCM,0)) AS ProcCM,

        SUM(ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0)) AS ZileCMUnitate,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0) - ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0) < 0
                THEN 0
                ELSE ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0) - ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0)
            END
        ) AS ZileCMFNUASS

    FROM app.ConcediuMedical

    WHERE LunadePlata = @Luna
      AND AnuldePlata = @Anul
      AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        Marca,
        CodSucursala,
        LunadePlata,
        AnuldePlata
) cm
    ON cm.Marca = ep.Marca
   AND cm.CodSucursala = ep.CodSucursala
   AND cm.Luna = ep.Luna
   AND cm.Anul = ep.Anul

WHERE ep.Luna = @Luna
  AND ep.Anul = @Anul
  AND ep.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

/*=====================================================
    10. Integrare Concedii Medicale
=====================================================*/

UPDATE sc
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Flag CM
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.EsteCM =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0) > 0
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile CM
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.ZileCM =
        ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0),

    sc.ZileAsimilate =
        ISNULL(cm.NrZileAsimilate,0),

    sc.ZileCMUnitate =
        ISNULL(cm.ZilePlatiteUnitate,0),

    sc.ZileCMFNUASS =
        ISNULL(cm.ZileCMFNUASS,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Venituri CM
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.VenitCM =
        ISNULL(cm.SumaUnitate,0),

    sc.VenitFNUASS =
        ISNULL(cm.SumaPlatitadinCAS,0)
        + ISNULL(cm.SumaPldinFondAcc,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Caracteristici CM
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.CodIndemnizatieCM =
        ISNULL(cm.CodIndemn,''),

    sc.CodUrgentaCM =
        ISNULL(TRY_CAST(cm.CodUrgenta AS INT),0),

    sc.ProcCM =
        ISNULL(cm.ProcentCM,0),

    sc.EsteCMContinuare =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.CMContinuare,'') IN ('D','DA','1')
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    sc.EsteCMCronic =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(cm.Cronic,'') IN ('D','DA','1')
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.LastModifiedDate =
        SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT

        Marca,
        CodSucursala,
        LunadePlata,
        AnuldePlata,

        SUM(ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0))      AS ZileCM,
        SUM(ISNULL(NrZileAsimilate,0))        AS NrZileAsimilate,

        SUM(ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0))     AS ZilePlatiteUnitate,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0)
                     - ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0) < 0
                THEN 0
                ELSE
                    ISNULL(TotZileLucratoare,0)
                    - ISNULL(ZilePlatiteUnitate,0)
            END
        ) AS ZileCMFNUASS,

        SUM(ISNULL(SumaUnitate,0))            AS SumaUnitate,

        SUM(ISNULL(SumaPlatitadinCAS,0))      AS SumaPlatitadinCAS,

        SUM(ISNULL(SumaPldinFondAcc,0))       AS SumaPldinFondAcc,

        MAX(Codindemn)                        AS CodIndemn,

        MAX(CodUrgenta)                       AS CodUrgenta,

        MAX(ProcentCM)                        AS ProcentCM,

        MAX(CMContinuare)                     AS CMContinuare,

        MAX(Cronic)                           AS Cronic

    FROM app.ConcediuMedical

    WHERE LunadePlata = @Luna
      AND AnuldePlata = @Anul
      AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY

        Marca,
        CodSucursala,
        LunadePlata,
        AnuldePlata

) cm

    ON cm.Marca = sc.Marca
   AND cm.CodSucursala = sc.CodSucursala
   AND cm.LunadePlata = sc.Luna
   AND cm.AnuldePlata = sc.Anul

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

/*=====================================================
    20. Calcul Stagiu Contributiv CAS
=====================================================*/

UPDATE sc
SET

    sc.ZileStagiuCAS =

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                ISNULL(sc.ZileLucrate,0)
                + ISNULL(sc.ZileCO,0)
                + ISNULL(sc.ZileCM,0)
                - ISNULL(sc.ZileCFS,0)
                - ISNULL(sc.ZileNemotivate,0)
            ) < 0
            THEN 0

            ELSE
                ISNULL(sc.ZileLucrate,0)
                + ISNULL(sc.ZileCO,0)
                + ISNULL(sc.ZileCM,0)
                - ISNULL(sc.ZileCFS,0)
                - ISNULL(sc.ZileNemotivate,0)
        END,

    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

SET

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna

/*=====================================================
    60. Calcul Tip Stagiu / Flag-uri Speciale
=====================================================*/

UPDATE sc
SET

    sc.TipStagiu =

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCCC,0) = 1
                THEN 'CCC'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCM,0) = 1
                THEN 'CM'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteAsimilat,0) = 1
                THEN 'ASIMILAT'

            ELSE 'CONTRIBUTIV'
        END,

    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

/*=====================================================
    70. Finalizare Snapshot Stagiu Cotizare
=====================================================*/

UPDATE sc
SET

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Procesare
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.EsteProcesat = 1,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.Status = 2,      -- Confirmat

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Validare
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.MesajValidare =

        CASE

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.ZileStagiuTotal,0) < 0
                THEN 'Eroare: zile stagiu total negative.'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCM,0) = 1
                 AND ISNULL(sc.CodIndemnizatieCM,'') = ''
                THEN 'Lipsește codul indemnizației CM.'

            WHEN ISNULL(sc.EsteCM,0) = 1
                 AND ISNULL(sc.ProcCM,0) = 0
                THEN 'Lipsește procentul indemnizației CM.'

            ELSE ''

        END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------

    sc.DataCalcul = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(),

    sc.LastModifiedDate = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StagiuCotizare sc

WHERE sc.Luna = @Luna
  AND sc.Anul = @Anul
  AND sc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;
